metabolic_cost_results.json.upstream_input_file: static-optimization activation file of the public OpenSim gait2392 example (adapted producer input)
metabolic_cost_results.json.notes: TEST REGISTRY, not a production registry. Producer: the adapted public gait2392/Umberger2010/Bhargava2004 metabolic-cost producer. Its OWN five producer gates report overall_pass=false (speed_sanity_ok=false, expected_direction_pass=false), so its real result (fixture public_control) is refused for scientific use. payload_sha256 pins the contract-test fixture contract_gates_pass (same numbers, gate outcome replaced for contract testing); it is not evidence. Acceptance means the quantities are traceable and unit/region/frame/time-consistent, not that the physiology is correct. regime=level_walking_steady_state; any other or missing regime is refused. Admission: payload_sha256 is written only by tests/fixtures/i1/build_fixtures.py and takes effect through a reviewed commit; no runtime code writes this file.

_note: Test pin for tests/test_*_preflight.py only. It is not the production registry: where a production registry lives and which BODYTWIN_EVIDENCE_MODE is the default are open decisions.
